//: The browser bundle, src/mating/, typechecked as what it is: DOM, and no Node. Its own
pass for the reason tsconfig.functions.json has one — the main config loads Node's
types, so a Node API in a module the bundle pulls in would typecheck there and fail in
a visitor's browser. Every file the bundle imports, vendored modules included, is
checked here through the import graph. `exclude` is reset because the base config
excludes entry.ts, the one file only this pass can check.
